subject: Application received: Backend Engineer
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Thanks for applying for the Backend Engineer position at ZenTech. We have received your application and resume. Our engineering team is currently reviewing submissions. If your profile matches our requirements, our recruiter will reach out within 5-7 business days.

subject: Direct Selection & Offer Letter - Pay Rs 4,999 Mandatory Training & Induction Fee
body:
Dear Candidate,

Congratulations! We are pleased to inform you that your profile has been selected for the position of Senior Fullstack Developer at Infosys Technologies with a CTC of 28.5 LPA.

Due to our corporate policy for immediate virtual onboarding, all selected candidates must deposit a 100% refundable Training & Equipment Security Fee of Rs. 4,999 via UPI to infosys.recruitment.nodal@okhdfcbank before 25 Oct 2026.

Please also reply with scanned copies of your Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and cancelled cheque to confirm your joining.

subject: Interview invite: Round 1 System Design on 27 Oct
body:
Hi Jayraj,

We were really impressed by your background and experience in building distributed systems! We would love to invite you for Round 1: System Design & Architecture with our Principal Architect.

The 45-minute discussion is scheduled for October 27, 2026 at 3:00 PM IST via Google Meet.

Please confirm if this time works for you.

subject: Application Acknowledgement: Senior Backend Engineer (Search & Discovery)
body:
Hello Jayraj,

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer role at Swiggy. Your application has been logged into our portal (REF: SWG-88219). Our talent team will evaluate your profile and update you on the next steps.

subject: Thanks for applying to Zomato - Frontend Engineer (React/TypeScript)
body:
Hey Jayraj,

We've received your application for the Frontend Engineer role at Zomato. We build lightning fast experiences for millions of foodies every day. We review applications regularly and will be in touch if your background aligns.

subject: Application submitted: Staff Software Engineer at Razorpay
body:
Dear Jayraj,

Thank you for applying to Razorpay. We are revolutionizing money movement for businesses. We have received your application for Staff Software Engineer. You will hear back from our hiring team shortly.

subject: Application Received - Zepto Quick Commerce (SDE II - Platform)
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Thank you for your interest in joining Zepto. We deliver 10-minute joy. Your application for SDE II - Platform is received. Our hiring managers review candidate profiles on a rolling basis.

subject: You have applied to CRED: Platform Engineer
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Thanks for expressing interest in building for the top 1% at CRED. Your application for Platform Engineer has been received. Our team will review your credentials and get back if there is a mutual fit.

subject: Interview Invitation: PhonePe Technical Screen (Round 1)
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Hope this email finds you well. The team at PhonePe was very glad to review your engineering work. We would like to schedule a 60-minute technical screening call covering Core Java/Node.js, concurrency, and DB indexing on October 28, 2026 at 11:30 AM IST.

Let us know if you are available.

subject: Postman - Next Steps: Live Architecture & Coding Round
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Great news! Your take-home challenge scored in the 95th percentile. We would like to advance you to the live architecture and API design round with our Engineering Director on October 29, 2026 at 4:00 PM IST.

Please find the calendar invite attached.

subject: Atlan Interview: Culture & Technical Deep Dive
body:
Hey Jayraj,

We loved your open-source projects! We are excited to invite you to a 60-minute discussion with our founders and engineering leads on October 30, 2026 at 2:00 PM IST.

Looking forward to meeting you virtually.

subject: URGENT: Mandatory Aadhaar, PAN & Bank Verification for Immediate Interview Scheduling
body:
Attention Candidate,

Your application has been shortlisted for Tata Consultancy Services (TCS Digital). Before we can issue your interview time slot, corporate KYC compliance requires you to immediately upload high-resolution photos of your original Aadhaar Card (both front and back), PAN card, and last 3 months salary slips by replying directly to this email within 6 hours. Failure to comply will lead to permanent blacklisting from all Tata group companies.

subject: Direct Appointment Letter & MacBook Pro Courier Dispatch - Courier Deposit Required
body:
Dear Jayraj,

Congratulations! Based on your profile on job portals, the hiring committee at Wipro Limited has appointed you as Lead Cloud Architect at 32 LPA without any preliminary interview.

A company MacBook Pro M3 and Welcome Kit are ready for dispatch to your address. You are required to pay a refundable courier insurance and asset security fee of Rs. 7,500 to our logistics partner account before dispatch. Account details: GPay/PhonePe to 9823419201.

subject: Earn Rs 1,20,000/Month Part-Time Work from Home - Immediate Start
body:
Hello Jobseeker,

Amazon India is hiring remote workers for order review and ratings. Work just 2 hours a day from your mobile phone and earn Rs. 4,000 to Rs. 8,000 daily payout directly to your bank account. No prior experience needed.

To claim your spot, join our official Telegram coordinator right now: https://t.me/fake_amazon_hiring_bot

subject: Update on your application with Atlassian
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us regarding the Senior Software Engineer role. While your technical skills and background are commendable, we have decided to move forward with candidates whose experience more closely matches our immediate infrastructure requirements.

We wish you all the best in your search.

subject: Your application to Stripe
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Thank you for your interest in Stripe and for investing your time in our interview process. We carefully considered your experience, but we have made the difficult decision not to extend an offer at this stage. We appreciate your effort and wish you success in your future endeavors.

subject: Status of your application at Uber
body:
Hi Jayraj,

Thank you for applying for the Backend Engineer role at Uber. After thorough evaluation, we will not be moving forward with your candidacy. We truly appreciate the opportunity to review your profile and wish you the best in your job search.

subject: Application Received: Senior Full Stack Engineer at Groww
body:
Hi Jayraj,

We have received your application for the Senior Full Stack Engineer role at Groww. Our talent acquisition team is currently reviewing your profile and will get back to you with next steps shortly.

subject: Thank you for applying to InMobi
body:
Hello Jayraj,

Your application for Staff Software Engineer has been successfully submitted. We appreciate your patience while our engineering managers review your portfolio and GitHub profile.

subject: Official Offer of Employment: Staff Software Engineer at BrowserStack
body:
Dear Jayraj,

Following your successful completion of all technical rounds and executive debrief, we are thrilled to offer you the position of Staff Software Engineer at BrowserStack!

Please find attached your formal offer letter detailing compensation, equity grants, and benefits. Please sign via DocuSign by October 30, 2026. Welcome to the team!
